question_text: A 75-year-old man comes to the physician because of fatigue and decreased urine output for 1 week. He takes ibuprofen as needed for lower back pain and docusate for constipation. Physical examination shows tenderness to palpation over the lumbar spine. There is pedal edema. Laboratory studies show a hemoglobin concentration of 8.7 g/dL, a serum creatinine concentration of 2.3 mg/dL, and a serum calcium concentration of 12.6 mg/dL. Urine dipstick is negative for blood and protein. Which of the following is the most likely underlying cause of this patient's symptoms?
